title: Print Document Intelligence Pipeline — Output
description: Schema for the JSON files written to output/ by the pipeline. One file per input image/PDF.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at which the output was written.

models.description: Active backends per pipeline stage. Values follow `<backend>:<model_name>` or just `<backend>` if no model name is set.

pipeline_version.description: Semver of the pipeline that produced this file.

publication.description: Present only when this input was processed as part of a publication folder. Each page-image of the publication produces its own JSON file linked through metadata.publication.name.

name.description: Publication identifier — basename of the publication folder. Used as the UNIQUE key in the publications table.

magazine_name.description: Parsed magazine name (the part before the trailing _<YYYY-MM-DD> or _<YYYY-MM> suffix). Falls back to the folder basename when the convention does not match.

issue_date.description: Parsed issue date in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM form, or null when the folder name does not match the convention.

source_path.description: Absolute path of the publication folder at processing time.

page_label.description: Page identifier within the publication. Initially the 1-based input order as a decimal string ("1", "2", ...). Free-form TEXT so non-numeric labels ("iv", "A12", "B3") can replace the auto-assigned value without a schema migration.

total_pages.description: Number of page-images in the publication folder at processing time.

pages.description: Per-page results. Image inputs produce one entry; PDFs produce one entry per page.

all_entities.description: Distinct entities across all pages, sorted by count descending.

all_detections_summary.description: Map of OWLv2 prompt label → total occurrences across all pages and regions. Sorted by count descending in the source object.

errors.description: Per-page failures captured during processing. Empty when the file processed cleanly. Format: `Page <N>: <ExceptionType>: <message>`.

bbox.description: Normalised bounding box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] with origin at top-left and values in [0, 1].

blockType.description: Layout class assigned by the layout stage.

entityLabel.description: Entity label after `label_remapping` is applied. spaCy's default vocabulary plus any custom remaps from config.yaml (e.g. ORG → BRAND).

page_number.description: 1-indexed page number within the source file.

classification.description: Heuristic page label produced at serialization time from text-block types and image-region detections. Tunable via config.yaml.page_classification. Replaceable later by a real classifier — the DB column accepts any string.

classification_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of which signal(s) drove the classification decision.

id.description: Page-scoped identifier, e.g. `tb_000`. Not unique across pages.

text.description: Recognised text. May contain `\n` newlines preserved from the OCR output.

bbox.description: Page-relative bounding box of the block.

text.description: The entity span as it appears in the parent block's text.

start.description: Character offset into the parent `text_blocks[].text` (inclusive). Newlines count as one character.

id.description: Page-scoped identifier, e.g. `ir_001`. Not unique across pages.

bbox.description: Page-relative bounding box of the image region (the cropped figure).

label.description: The OWLv2 prompt that matched. Comes from `detection_prompts` in config.yaml (e.g. `person`, `brand logo`, `handbag`, `product advertisement`).

bbox.description: CROP-relative bounding box (relative to the parent `image_regions[].bbox`, NOT the full page). Compose with the parent bbox to get page-relative coordinates.
